$comment: Products with variants (D3, issue #73). The importer joins the source products listed under `values` into one
product with combinations. The first value is the default variant: its source product gives the product its
description, brand, VAT and `reference`, which is how the next run finds the product again. The other source
products are not imported on their own. Each combination takes the price, weight, EAN, images and stock of its
own source product. To add a variant, add a line to `values` and run the import (deploy/importer/README.md).
Why the products are joined this way: docs/adr/0009-variants-as-combinations-of-source-families.md
